facts.fact: The director general of digital transformation says a Prime Minister's circular enjoins the various actors to give priority to hosting at national level, and that requests for platform operation are screened for where data is hosted; the circular's own date is not given, so the interview's published date of 2026-03-03 is used.
facts.system: Circulaire du Premier ministre on national hosting

note: Interview on the decree setting the terms for putting state digital platforms into operation; the decree itself has no explicit local-hosting rule, no named hosting that bodies must use and no count of moves, so no fact on use.
